opening.argument: The material promotes a PUBG Mobile hack offering free UC and Battle Points, then directs viewers through a generator page that requests a username and device. The title promises “Free UC and Battle Points on Android/iOS,” while the page visibly instructs users to enter their username and select their device. The participation flow continues with an instruction to download and open two apps for at least 30 seconds, followed by an App Store page for Castle Clash. These steps establish a low-barrier reward-acquisition scheme presented as a way to obtain in-game resources. The frames do not establish that the resources were delivered or that any account change or loss occurred.
